_comment: COPY THIS FILE to config.json and add only the keys you intend to use. The current runtime needs a supported model provider for BARS chat and mission debriefs. Everything else is optional. Never paste production keys into chat or commit them to Git.

model._comment: Current runtime provider configuration. OpenRouter-compatible routing is supported by the existing model layer when base_url/model are configured appropriately.

elevenlabs._voice: OPTIONAL premium voice. Without a key BARS can use the browser's built-in speech voice.
elevenlabs._expressive: Used for expressive delivery when supported. Falls back to model_id if unavailable.

openai._comment: OPTIONAL — powers the LIVE realtime voice path and high-accuracy dictation when configured.

takeover._comment: Computer-use reasoning preset. Takeover still requires the explicit confirmation boundary and must retain the emergency stop.

hue._comment: OPTIONAL Philips Hue — room reacts to BARS events. Pairing/runtime state belongs in bars-hue.json; legacy tars-hue.json may be read only for migration compatibility.

picovoice._comment: OPTIONAL trained 'Hey BARS' wake word. Keep the ordinary speech-to-text fallback so wake-word setup is never required for basic use.

trail_mixx._comment: Reserved for the governed Trail Mixx/AzuraCast adapter. Do not enable write actions until the adapter and approval boundary are verified.
